model_annotation: The bar chart displays the negative log probability of various medical specialties, categorized by per-specialty terms, for the Mistralv0.2-Base model fine-tuned on different clinical domains. The x-axis represents the specialty categories—Cardio, Gastro, Infect, Neuro, Obstetrics, and Pediatrics—arranged in order from left to right. The y-axis, labeled "Negative log probability," ranges from -22 to -27, with values decreasing downward. For each specialty, multiple bars are shown, each representing a different fine-tuning dataset: Cardio (lightest orange), Gastro (medium orange), Infect (darker orange), Neuro (darker brown), Obstetrics (dark brown), and Pediatrics (darkest brown). The blue bar, labeled "Mistralv0.2-Base," appears to represent the baseline model performance for each specialty. The bars for each specialty are grouped together, with the baseline model's performance (blue) generally showing a higher negative log probability (i.e., better performance) compared to the fine-tuned models. Within each group, the bars for the fine-tuned models show varying performance, with the "Pediatrics" fine-tuned model often having the lowest negative log probability (worst performance) among the fine-tuned models for that specialty. The chart illustrates how fine-tuning the model on specific medical domains affects its performance on different specialty terms.
